description: VNX feature-execution kickoff preflight. USE THIS when starting or resuming a feature or track from its plan: checking worktree/queue health, finding the first promoteable deliverable, and handing off to @t0-orchestrator. Reads the feature's track + plan doc from Horizon's tracks DB (`vnx horizon`, alias `vnx objective`); the repo FEATURE_PLAN.md/PR_QUEUE.md are generated examples, not the source, and kickoff never initializes or promotes from them.
